title: Add Stripe 3-D Secure payment handling
description: Handle the 3-D Secure result returned by Stripe and show payment failure guidance during checkout.
acceptance_criteria: A card requiring 3-D Secure can complete authentication and create a paid order.

title: Add Coinbase Commerce payments
description: Allow customers to pay with cryptocurrency through Coinbase Commerce webhooks.
acceptance_criteria: A confirmed Coinbase payment creates a paid order.

title: Build native Android shopping application
description: Create an Android application for catalogue, cart and checkout using the same backend.
acceptance_criteria: The application is published to an internal Android testing track.

title: Add Apple social login
description: Allow customers to register and sign in with their Apple account.
acceptance_criteria: A customer can create an account using Sign in with Apple.

title: Configure Google Analytics purchase event
description: Send the contracted purchase event to the Client's GA4 property after checkout succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: The GA4 debug view receives a purchase event containing order value and currency.

title: Support partial Stripe refunds
description: Allow an administrator to refund selected order items instead of the full payment.
acceptance_criteria: An administrator can enter a partial refund amount and Stripe records it.

title: Update checkout
description: Please make the requested checkout improvements from today's call.

title: Add product comparison table
description: Let customers select up to four products and compare their attributes side by side.
acceptance_criteria: Selected product specifications appear in one comparison table.

title: Import ten thousand products from approved CSV
description: Run the final product import using the agreed Client CSV structure.
acceptance_criteria: Valid rows are imported with SKU, price, category, variants and image references.

title: Integrate WhatsApp order notifications
description: Send order confirmation and shipment updates through WhatsApp Business.
acceptance_criteria: Customers receive WhatsApp messages after payment and shipment creation.

title: Add Shiprocket tracking status to order history
description: Display the latest tracking status returned by the contracted Shiprocket integration.
acceptance_criteria: A signed-in customer sees the Shiprocket tracking number and latest status for a shipped order.

title: Create sales forecasting dashboard
description: Predict next-month sales by category and show the forecast to administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Administrators can see predicted sales and download the forecast.
